title: The fixed scalar representative is the inverse mate of exact scalar restriction localization.
statement: Let A and B be arbitrary commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism, T a scheme, and P any cochain complex of A-module sheaves on the small etale site of T. Under the ordinary cochain scalar adjunction and the chosen derived scalar adjunction, the inverse mate of the inverse localization factor for scalar restriction, evaluated at P, equals scalarExtensionRepresentative φ T P. No flatness hypothesis on P or B is required.

source.place: Proof step 1: the scalar representative transposes to the localized ordinary scalar unit. Stacks 0E8I, 03DI, 03EK and 06YY.

proof.text: Evaluate the ordinary cochain scalar adjunction unit degree by degree. Its component is the ordinary scalar adjunction unit, so the cochain unit is scalarRepresentativeUnit after cancelling the identity-complex and composition comparison isomorphisms.

The unit_mateEquiv_symm identity computes the transpose of the inverse mate as Q applied to that cochain unit followed by the inverse exact scalar restriction factor. The published scalarExtensionRepresentative_unit_public formula gives exactly the same transpose for scalarExtensionRepresentative. The derived scalar adjunction hom equivalence is injective, so the two representatives are equal.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleScalarRepresentativeMate
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    ((mateEquiv
      ((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction φ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ))).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv)).app P =
      scalarExtensionRepresentative φ T P
